prompt:
Use case: photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 熊; subject ID bear only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white horizontal seams approximately 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Top photograph: a complete adult brown bear walking naturally across grassy ground in its natural habitat, three-quarter side view, showing thick brown fur, small rounded ears, four sturdy limbs and paws. All of the bear fits comfortably in the frame.
Middle photograph: a complete adult brown bear sitting naturally on grassy ground, calm neutral posture, visible small round ears and forepaws, photographed from a safe remote viewpoint.
Bottom photograph: a complete adult brown bear resting naturally on grassy ground, lying comfortably with its head and body clearly visible, not asleep in a human setting.
Composition/framing: three standalone wide landscape photos in this exact order, each with its bear centered and at least 10 percent safe space on all sides; all paws, ears and body remain inside the panel. Grass and soft distant woodland provide uncluttered natural backgrounds. Each independently cropped panel must clearly show a real brown bear, not a toy.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic wildlife photography, natural individual fur strands, believable animal anatomy and grass texture, gentle natural daylight, true-to-life colors and soft shadows.
Constraints: natural safe wildlife views from a distant camera; no people, approaching, feeding, handling, bait, captivity props or anthropomorphism. No clothing on animals. Exactly three panels and two white seams. No writing, captions, labels, letters, numbers, logos, cartoon, illustration, watermark or decorative graphics.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview, never the full original PNG. Top shows a brown bear walking on grass; middle shows a seated brown bear; bottom shows a reclining brown bear resting on grass. Complete visible silhouettes have crop-safe margins, with natural fur, woodland and daylight. No visible people, feeding, anthropomorphism, writing or watermark at preview resolution; fine details are not verified. Sharp raw-pixel measurement of the 1024x1792 source found white seam rows 589–597 and 1184–1191; rounded centers are 593 and 1188. Panels differ slightly in height.
